name: cli-terminal-section
purpose: The Azion CLI band of a product page: a horizontal section title with one outlined button, over a terminal on the pixelate texture that runs off the frame's bottom rule. The terminal is either a recorded Azion CLI session typed live by a `console-mockup` (`script`), in a fixed-height stage that rises in when it scrolls into view, or a static session whose lines enter one after another (`session`). It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'cli-terminal-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `module`, `module-header`, `button`, `registration-frame`, `texture`, `console-mockup` and `code-block`.
useWhen: Use CliTerminalSection only on marketing pages for a full-width terminal session.
To close a product argument on how little it takes to ship from the terminal, like Functions and Workloads.
avoidWhen: For a config file or handler beside the claim → use `feature-scroll-section` with a `code` step.
For several capabilities, each with its own file → use `feature-scroll-section` with code items.
related: `code-block` — the terminal session the band shows.
`feature-scroll-section` — the walkthrough whose steps can each pin a code sample (`code`).
bestPractices: Keep the session to a few commands and their output; comment the output lines so the copied text still runs.
Name the copy button with `copyAriaLabel` so a screen reader says what it copies.
Prefer `script` on a product page: `start` types the first-project session, `deploy` the deploy session. Use `session` for a command set the recordings do not cover.
Set `anchor` when a hero button scrolls to this band.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the horizontal section title as its `h2`; the band renders no header when empty.

props.name: script
props.doc: Recorded Azion CLI session the terminal types live: `start` or `deploy`; wins over `session`.

props.name: session
props.doc: The terminal session shown under the header when no `script` is set, commands and their output verbatim, highlighted as bash; the band renders nothing when neither is set.

props.name: copyAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the session's copy button; empty keeps the code block's own.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: Outlined button in the section title; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Omitted when absent.
